brief: Three bases arranged around an empty spot, with a bay tray standing in that spot.

requirements.requirement: Three bases arranged around an empty spot
requirements.evidence: Pieces at q=-1,r=1; q=0,r=1; q=1,r=0 form three consecutive neighbors of central cell q=0,r=0 (each distance 1 from center, pairwise adjacent where expected). Central cell 0,0 is empty of bases, creating the void.

requirements.requirement: Bay tray standing in that empty spot
requirements.evidence: bay:0#0,0#bay4 at 0,0 stem hex-bin-bay-s-full-solid (k=4) bolted to all three surrounding bases; check_build meshClash=clear, no errors.

finish.summary: Build has three full hex bases at (-1,1,0), (0,1,0) and (1,0,0) surrounding empty hex (0,0). A full bay tray (hex-bin-bay-s-full-solid) occupies the empty spot, verified by socket offer and meshClash clear.

lines.label: M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
